rag.text:
Test: TC-3337 — Feature area - Box - Attributes displaying and editing - Changing Jira sprint name and status
Priority: High | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-88 Feature area - Box - Attributes displaying and editing
Labels: can_be_automated, rocksolid, teamagile

Description:
Changing status and name in Jira works for any BP module with visible sub-boxes

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Jira projectName backlog
   Data: projectName: TC-3337 Changing Jira sprint name and status
   Expected: Backlog of the projectName is visible. Three sprints are visible. Start sprint button is visible next to the sprint TC3337 Sprint 1
2. Click on the Start sprint button and click Start button in the modal window
   Expected: Active sprint screen of 'TC3337 Sprint 1' is visible. Complete sprint button in the top right corner is visible.
3. Click on the Complete sprint button in the top right corner and click Complete button in the modal window
   Expected: Sprint report screen is visible
4. Click on the Backlog button from the left side Jira menu
*On Cloud:*

Click Back to project and then click on Backlog button from the left side of Jira menu
   Expected: Two sprints are visible. Start sprint button is visible next to the sprint TC3337 Sprint 2
5. Click on the Start sprint button and click Start button in the modal window
   Expected: Active sprint screen of 'TC3337 Sprint 2' is visible.
Complete sprint button in the top right corner is visible.
6. Navigate to the Overview module  of the boxName and expand the hierarchy tree

*NOTE*
On cloud it may take more time to display updated boxes status
   Data: boxName: TC-3337 Feature area - Box - Attributes displaying and editing - Changing Jira sprint name and status
   Expected: Three iterations are visible:
- TC3337 Sprint 1 - with status "closed"
- TC3337 Sprint 2 - with status "in progress"
- TC3337 Sprint 3 - with status "not started"
7. Navigate to the Jira projectName backlog again
   Data: projectName: TC-3337 Changing Jira sprint name and status
   Expected: Two sprints are visible. Three dots button is visible next to each sprint
8. Click on the Three dots button next to TC3337 Sprint 3
   Expected: Dropdown menu is visible with Edit sprint option
9. Click on Edit sprint option
   Expected: Edit modal is visible
10. Change the Sprint Name to sprintName and save
   Data: sprintName: Changed name
   Expected: The name of the sprint is changed to 'Changed name'
11. Navigate to the Board module  of the boxName
*NOTE*
On cloud it may take more time to display updated boxes status
   Data: boxName: TC-3337 Feature area - Box - Attributes displaying and editing - Changing Jira sprint name and status
   Expected: Three sub-boxes are visible:
- TC3337 Sprint 1 - with status "closed"
- TC3337 Sprint 2 - with status "in progress"
- Changed name - with status "not started"
